prompt:
Open input.docx with the current jubarte CLI at {binary}. The document has pending tracked changes from prior reviewers. In a single command invocation:

1. Reject revision r1 (sara.k's insertion of "no backend required" in p6).
2. In paragraph p6, replace "browser" with "client" (we want to rename the noun).

Use --author {author} for the new edit. Write the result to {output}. End your reply with exactly one line:

JUBARTE_RESULT: success

when the artifact at {output} no longer contains "browser" in p6 (PilotBot's revision of that span) and r1 has been rejected (its insertion is gone); otherwise:

JUBARTE_RESULT: failed

Do not print anything after that line.

rubric.description: r1 was rejected by an explicit --reject flag, not silently absorbed; the receipt names the rejected revision id.
